title: Request to Correct My Health Record
about: A patient's request to correct or add to their record. HIPAA right to amend, 45 CFR 164.526.

licence.terms: CC0 1.0: dedicated to the public domain. Use and adapt it freely, with no credit needed.

fields.label: Date of the record (visit, test or letter)
Who else should be told about the correction (name and address)

blocks.text: We will answer within 60 days. If we need more time, we will tell you why in writing. If we say no, we will tell you why in writing. You may then send us a statement that you disagree, and we will add it to your record.

blocks.label: Decision
items: Not corrected: we did not create this record
Not corrected: not part of the record
Not corrected: not open to the patient to see or copy
Not corrected: the record is correct and complete
